insights: Vintage and heritage pieces drive clicks
The Vintage Red Tab™ T-shirt reaches 1.84 times the average CTR, the Vintage Boxy sweatshirt 1.31 times and the Trucker jacket 1.38 times.
Put vintage and heritage pieces forward in the campaign.
Men's jeans reach 1.13 times the average and women's jeans 1.05 times. The XL Straight jean reaches 1.28 times.
Keep jeans at the centre, with a focus on relaxed and straight fits.
Belts, beanies and caps stay at 0.49 times the average.
Show accessories as a complement once the shopper has found their jeans.
Jackets and sweats reach 1.24 times the average and skirts and dresses 1.20 times.
Push outerwear for the cold season (Trucker, sherpa, sweats).
